findings.text: follow-on: the declared-server entry's accelerator_family is taken from the declaration (imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:546), and for a site that declares no servers the declaration is the fallback built in imas_ambix/agent/profile.py:687-698, which sets only name, host, partition, account and reservation. accelerator_family then falls to the pydantic class default "H200" (imas_ambix/agent/profile.py:525), and SiteConfig has no flat accelerator_family field to stand in for it, so the document publishes "H200" as though the site had declared it. The sibling card count in the same entry is null for exactly the same reason (no declaration), which is the rule the window's last commit applied to the count; the family keeps the pre-change behaviour's source only on the undeclared-host path (imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:561, which takes the engine's family). On a site running a family other than the default, the document would now state a family the hardware does not have, where the code at the reviewed base reported the engine's own. No test covers the family of a declared entry built from the flat fields, so nothing would redden.

follow-on: this assertion is a verbatim duplicate of the line above it (tests/test_agent_site_servers.py:282), so it adds no coverage and reads, to a later reader skimming the new test, as though two separate properties of the undeclared-host entry were checked. The assertion that carries the test's point is the count one at tests/test_agent_site_servers.py:287.

raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the goal is that SiteConfig declares a list of servers, serve places onto a named server, and endpoints.json lists each server with its engines deduplicated by engine id; the commits gained since the reviewed base (aa67fe56, 970c999b) close the remaining gap by building the servers array from the declaration at imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:539-556, so a declared server with no engine is still a row, and by publishing a card count only where one is declared at imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:543-565.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when names the pytest command over the three test files plus a whole-tree ruff check; tests/test_agent_endpoint_discovery.py:265 asserts the complete published document, servers array included, through the production publish path (registry_mod.main(["publish", ...]) at tests/test_agent_endpoint_discovery.py:190), and tests/test_agent_site_servers.py:170-296 assert the declared-server rules; the manifest records `45 passed, EXIT=0` and `All checks passed, EXIT=0`, and gate.log and ruff.log both end in a bare `EXIT=0`.
VERDICT write_paths: the reviewed node declares eight paths; `git diff --stat c09e6a2a090111bd659359b33aa56fbb13e745b2 970c999b92d94a6db3faafefe0bbc02caad9f195` touches exactly five of them -- docs/evidence/fragments/serving-across-servers/servers-declared-once.html, imas_ambix/agent/cli.py, imas_ambix/agent/registry.py, tests/test_agent_endpoint_discovery.py, tests/test_agent_site_servers.py -- and nothing outside them.
VERDICT manifest: read at the reviewed head; it names the four commits, the pytest command and `45 passed, EXIT=0`, the ruff command and `All checks passed, EXIT=0`, gate.log and negative_control.log, and the worktree is clean at 970c999b; its `tests:` receipt is still the ruff line rather than the pytest line, which the earlier review recorded at manifest.md:22 and which is unchanged in this window; it carries no baseline_suite or after_suite arm, so no suite delta is derivable from it.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit -- aa67fe56 moves the servers array onto the declared servers (imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:517-565) and threads them through cli.py:1207 and registry.py:806; 970c999b stops promoting an engine's card count to the node and publishes null where nothing is declared (imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:543-565); the test changes replace the engine-derived expectations with declaration-derived ones and add four tests, and the fragment records the rule and two further negative controls.
CALL_SITES: imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:1204 (_republish_endpoint_document, passes site.declared_servers), imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:677 (serve), imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:1175 (shutdown), imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:2710 (_execute_restart_cycle), imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:803 (main, the publish command), imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:592 (write_endpoint_document, serialises the servers array), imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:865 (_same_node, compares a host against document entries)
SCORE goal_fidelity: 19
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:539-556 now emits one row per declared server, engines or none, so the document states the site's servers rather than only the ones currently serving, which is the half of the goal the array could not express before.
SCORE evidence: 18
JUSTIFICATION evidence: tests/test_agent_endpoint_discovery.py:265 pins the whole published document against a literal oracle through the production publish path, and the four negative controls in negative_control.log each end `EXIT=1` with a failing id the head run does not fail; the receipt is weaker than it could be because the reviewed run recorded no baseline_suite or after_suite arm and the gate logs (gate.log:1) name the command but neither the revision nor the tree.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: every path in the diff against the reviewed base is one of the node's declared write paths, and the added PublishedServer fields (imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:222-224) publish declarations the preceding commit had already made without a consumer.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_agent_site_servers.py:224 would redden on the reinstated regression (negative control 3 in negative_control.log reports `assert 4 == 8`, EXIT=1) and tests/test_agent_site_servers.py:245 reddens on the restored engine fallback (`assert 4 is None`, mutation 4), both comparing against literals the test supplies rather than against a value the code returns; the family rule at imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:546 has no such test.
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: the new helpers follow the module's private-helper idiom beside imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:35-66, the extraction of `_short_host` out of `_engine_id` keeps one derivation of the short name, and no added symbol, comment or test name carries a plan, stage or ticket identifier.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the servers array stays in imas_ambix/agent/registry.py, the document's owner, and I searched for an existing owner of the two added capabilities: host-shortening (imas_ambix/agent/node_probe.py:647 `scheduler_node_name` cuts at the FQDN dot, a different relation) and name-to-server resolution (imas_ambix/agent/profile.py:699 `resolve_server`, which matches on the declaration name alone and refuses an unknown one rather than tolerating a host spelling).
FINDING imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:546 follow-on: accelerator_family comes from the declaration, and an unconfigured site's fallback declaration (imas_ambix/agent/profile.py:687-698) sets no family, so the pydantic default "H200" (imas_ambix/agent/profile.py:525) is published as a declared fact while the count beside it is null for the same reason.
FINDING tests/test_agent_site_servers.py:283 follow-on: the assertion duplicates tests/test_agent_site_servers.py:282 verbatim, adding no coverage to the new test.
